rows.note: Use 廢話 as the all-purpose choice for silly, illogical, or pointless talk.

example.english: Why are you talking so much nonsense?
example.jyutping: nei5 gong2 gam3 do1 fai3 waa6 zou6 mat1

rows.note: Pick 大話 when “nonsense” means a lie or a deliberately untrue statement.

example.english: They told nonsense, claiming they had finished the job.
example.traditional: 佢哋講大話，話自己做完份工。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 gong2 daai6 waa6 waa6 zi6 gei2 zou6 jyun4 fan6 gung1

rows.note: Use 一嚿雲 for speech that comes out as an incoherent, unintelligible jumble.

example.english: When you get nervous, you start talking nonsense.
example.traditional: 你一緊張就講到一嚿雲。
example.jyutping: nei5 jat1 gan2 zoeng1 zau6 gong2 dou2 jat1 gau6 wan4

rows.note: Use 天書 for writing or technical text that is impossible for the listener or reader to understand.

example.english: This report is complete nonsense to me—I can't understand it.
example.traditional: 呢份報告對我嚟講簡直係天書。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 deoi3 ngo5 lei4 gong2 gaan2 zik6 hai6 tin1 syu1
